title: [Bug Fix] #638688: Suppress availability warning for Transfer WIP Item lines
summary: Transfer order lines flagged as WIP items now skip the standard item-availability warning check since WIP items are intermediate goods managed by subcontracting, not subject to regular inventory constraints.
key_points: Added event subscriber to suppress availability check for Transfer WIP Item lines
Prevents incorrect inventory warnings for intermediate goods in subcontracting workflow
Non-WIP transfer lines continue to perform availability checks as before
Includes tests to verify WIP lines skip the check while non-WIP lines remain unchanged
Uses feature flag guard to ensure compatibility with legacy versions
quote: Suppresses the standard item-availability warning when the Quantity is changed on a Transfer Order line flagged as Transfer WIP Item.
